top_signals.title: Sunak, Gray, Chandrasekaran on Geopolitics, AI
top_signals.summary: Speaking in New Delhi at Bloomberg's New Economy Forum, former UK Prime Minister Rishi Sunak, Blackstone President and COO Jonathan Gray, and Tata Sons Chairman Natarajan Chandrasekaran discuss how AI adoption will fundamentally reshape both financial movements and geopolitical realities. (Corrects title of Gray.) (Source: Bloomberg)
